title: Frog waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Frog body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="32" ry="24" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="30" ry="22" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- Left eye bump -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="28" r="12" fill="#81C784"/>
  <!-- Right eye bump -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="28" r="12" fill="#81C784"/>
  <!-- Left eye white -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="27" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Right eye white -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="27" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Left pupil -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="27" r="4" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <!-- Right pupil -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="27" r="4" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <!-- Eye shine left -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Eye shine right -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M38 50 Q50 62 62 50" stroke="#2E7D32" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left cheek -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="48" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#F48FB1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Right cheek -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="48" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#F48FB1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Left arm (on body) -->
  <path d="M22 70 Q14 65 16 58" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left hand -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="56" r="5" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- Right arm waving up -->
  <path d="M78 68 Q88 56 86 42" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right hand waving -->
  <circle cx="86" cy="40" r="6" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- Fingers on waving hand -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="35" r="2.5" fill="#81C784"/>
  <circle cx="87" cy="33" r="2.5" fill="#81C784"/>
  <circle cx="91" cy="36" r="2.5" fill="#81C784"/>
  <!-- Left foot -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="93" rx="12" ry="5" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <!-- Right foot -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="93" rx="12" ry="5" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <!-- Left toes -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="93" r="3" fill="#43A047"/>
  <circle cx="29" cy="95" r="3" fill="#43A047"/>
  <!-- Right toes -->
  <circle cx="71" cy="95" r="3" fill="#43A047"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="93" r="3" fill="#43A047"/>
</svg>
